sentences.text: Joffrey Baratheon is a fictional character in the A Song of Ice and Fire series of epic fantasy novels by American author George R. R. Martin , and its television adaptation Game of Thrones .	A Song of Ice and Fire	A Song of Ice and Fire	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	George R. R. Martin	George R. R. Martin	fictional character	fictional character	epic fantasy	epic fantasy

Introduced in 1996 's A Game of Thrones , Joffrey is the eldest son of Cersei Lannister from the kingdom of Westeros .	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	Cersei Lannister	Cersei Lannister	Westeros	Westeros
He subsequently appeared in Martin 's A Clash of Kings -LRB- 1998 -RRB- and A Storm of Swords -LRB- 2000 -RRB- .	A Storm of Swords	A Storm of Swords	A Clash of Kings	A Clash of Kings
Joffrey is portrayed by Irish actor Jack Gleeson in the HBO television adaptation .	Jack Gleeson	Jack Gleeson	HBO	HBO
In 2016 , Rolling Stone ranked the character # 4 in their list of the `` 40 Greatest TV Villains of All Time '' .	Rolling Stone	Rolling Stone
